summary:
Fixed the split-brain bug in [node.go](/app/app/cluster/node.go): leader election now requires a true majority with `(totalNodes/2)+1`, so a 2-node minority partition in a 5-node cluster cannot elect a leader. I also corrected the leader log argument order.

Added a regression test in [node_test.go](/app/app/cluster/node_test.go) covering the minority partition case.

Verification passed:
- `go test ./...`
- `./test.sh`

I also rebuilt `/usr/local/bin/split-brain` because `test.sh` invokes that binary from `PATH`.
